description: This file contains functions and classes for generating and fuzzing PyTorch tensors, including random tensor shapes, strides, and data types, as well as scalars. It appears to be a utility module used for testing or experimental purposes within the Torchfuzz project.

classes.name: FuzzerConfig
classes.description: Global configuration class for tensor fuzzing behavior, including flags to control data value generation and complexity avoidance.

classes.name: TensorSpec
classes.description: Specification class for tensor arguments, including size, stride, and data type.

classes.name: ScalarSpec
classes.description: Specification class for scalar arguments, including data type and optional constant value.

methods.name: torch.dtype fuzz_torch_tensor_type(template: str = "default")
methods.description: Fuzzes and randomly returns a PyTorch tensor data type based on a provided template.

methods.name: tuple[int,...] fuzz_tensor_size(max_dims: int = 3, max_size_per_dim: int = 30)
methods.description: Generates a random tensor shape with variable dimensions and sizes.

methods.name: tuple[int,...] fuzz_valid_stride(size: tuple[int, ...])
methods.description: Creates valid stride patterns for a tensor given its shape.

methods.name: list[int] _compute_contiguous_strides(size: tuple[int, ...])
methods.description: Helper function to compute standard contiguous strides for a tensor shape.

methods.name: list[int] _compute_non_contiguous_dense_strides(size: tuple[int, ...])
methods.description: Helper function to compute non-contiguous but dense strides, supporting different dense layout patterns.

methods.name: tuple[torch.Tensor,int] fuzz_tensor( size: tuple[int, ...] | None = None, stride: tuple[int, ...] | None = None, dtype: torch.dtype | None = None, seed: int | None = None, )
methods.description: Creates a strided tensor with fuzzed or specified size, stride, and dtype, optionally with reproducible randomness.

methods.name: torch.Tensor fuzz_tensor_simple( size: tuple[int, ...] | None = None, stride: tuple[int, ...] | None = None, dtype: torch.dtype | None = None, seed: int | None = None, )
methods.description: Simplified version of fuzz_tensor that returns just the tensor, not the seed.

methods.name: torch.Tensor fuzz_non_contiguous_dense_tensor( size: tuple[int, ...] | None = None, dtype: torch.dtype | None = None )
methods.description: Generates tensors that are non-contiguous but dense and non-overlapping.

methods.name: float|int|bool|complex fuzz_scalar(spec, seed: int | None = None)
methods.description: Creates a scalar value matching a ScalarSpec, using constants or random values based on dtype.

methods.name: bool specs_compatible(spec1: Spec, spec2: Spec)
methods.description: Checks whether two specifications are compatible (e.g., shape and dtype match).

ctags.name: avoid_complex
ctags.pattern: /^    avoid_complex: bool = False  # If True, exclude complex dtypes from fuzzing$/

ctags.name: fuzz_non_contiguous_dense_tensor
ctags.signature: ( size: tuple[int, ...] | None = None, dtype: torch.dtype | None = None )

ctags.name: fuzz_scalar
ctags.pattern: /^def fuzz_scalar(spec, seed: int | None = None) -> float | int | bool | complex:$/

ctags.name: fuzz_tensor
ctags.signature: ( size: tuple[int, ...] | None = None, stride: tuple[int, ...] | None = None, dtype: torch.dtype | None = None, seed: int | None = None, )

ctags.name: fuzz_tensor_simple
ctags.signature: ( size: tuple[int, ...] | None = None, stride: tuple[int, ...] | None = None, dtype: torch.dtype | None = None, seed: int | None = None, )

ctags.name: use_real_values
ctags.pattern: /^    use_real_values: bool = True  # If False, use zeros; if True, use random values$/
